array.string: REPO=/Volumes/NIMROD_SSD/Qwen-Weight-Space/valedia-trader D=/Volumes/NIMROD_SSD/Qwen-Weight-Space/valedia-deploy/collector echo "=== $(date '+%F %T') order-book collector starting" if [ ! -x "$REPO/.venv/bin/python" ] || [ ! -d "$D/valedia_trader" ]; then echo "SSD not mounted or the pinned copy is missing; will try again in a minute"; exit 1; fi cd "$D" || exit 1 export PYTHONPATH="$D" PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 exec "$REPO/.venv/bin/python" -m valedia_trader.research_loop.orderbook_loop collect --db "$REPO/memory/orderbook_loop.sqlite"
